scripts.dev:host: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "bun run --filter web dev" "uv run --directory api fastapi dev main.py --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory api fastapi dev main.py --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.lint: bun run --filter web lint && uv run --directory api ruff check .
scripts.format: prettier --write "web/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,css,json,md}" "*.{json,md,yml,yaml}" && uv run --directory api ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "web/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,css,json,md}" "*.{json,md,yml,yaml}" && uv run --directory api ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter web build && uv run --directory api ty check
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck
